title: Ascendant Impact — adversarial QA oracle
note: Every constant below was measured in the live editor and recorded with its milestone. This agent reads them and never writes them. All values remain provisional and pending playtest.

scope.basis: the live graybox duel in game/, fifteen validated milestones
scope.not_basis: the GDD combat economy — the Ascension Meter, Impact Windows and the Final Clash are deferred whole by decision D1 (2026-08-23, design/decisions.md)

attack_range.note: combat-axis separation gate; widened from 190 2D in the 16.4 fix

cancellable_seconds_per_attack.note: windup 1.1 + impact delay 0.3; any player hit in this span cancels and rerolls the full cooldown

max_health.note: hardcoded in both the proxy graph and the HUD divisor — see K5

invariants.statement: Both fighters stay inside the combat-axis bounds of plus or minus 650.
invariants.detect: abs(x) > combat_axis_max + position_tolerance_cm sustained beyond correction_frames

invariants.statement: Axis separation never drops below MinimumAxisSeparation 78 for longer than the correction window.
invariants.detect: separation < minimum_axis_separation sustained beyond correction_frames, while not crossing

invariants.statement: Capsules never interpenetrate: separation is always at least 69 cm.
invariants.detect: separation < capsule_contact_distance at any sample, crossing included
invariants.note: 15.3 records that overlap below 69 never occurred in validation

invariants.statement: The Vanguard stays within its authored depth lane.
invariants.detect: vanguard Y outside the lane clamp read from the mover CDO
invariants.lane_bound_source: read from CDO at run start; never hardcoded here

invariants.statement: While no crossing is active, the sign of (vanguardX - playerX) equals CurrentSideSign.
invariants.detect: sign mismatch while bCrossingActive is false and player is grounded

invariants.statement: Every crossing closes: bCrossingActive returns to false once the player is grounded.
invariants.detect: bCrossingActive true while player grounded beyond stuck_seconds

invariants.statement: The mover is never left locked while the attack driver is idle.
invariants.detect: bExternalMovementLocked true while AttackState == 0 beyond stuck_seconds

invariants.statement: The Vanguard never parks legally inside its hold band yet outside its own attack gate and stops attacking.
invariants.detect: axis separation <= attack_range continuously while AttackState stays 0 past attack_cooldown_max plus several retry_delay rolls
invariants.regression_of: 16.4 failure 1 — gate was 2D distance <= 190, mover held to 225, Vanguard settled at 209 and never attacked again

invariants.statement: A ragdoll never settles below the floor plane.
invariants.detect: mesh Z < ground_plane_z - position_tolerance_cm after impact_to_ragdoll_delay

invariants.statement: The duel always remains progressable: at least one fighter can still lose health.
invariants.detect: both alive and no damage event from either side sustained beyond stuck_seconds while in range

invariants.statement: No damage event lands on a fighter that is already knocked out.
invariants.detect: health delta on a fighter whose KO flag is set

invariants.statement: Punch cadence cannot outrun the bIsAttacking re-entry guard.
invariants.detect: damage events per second above what the guard and montage length permit

invariants.statement: Collision-ignore never leaks past a knockout.
invariants.detect: bCrossingActive true after either KO flag sets
invariants.regression_of: 22 added StopMover -> SetCrossingCollisionEnabled(false) precisely for this

invariants.statement: Jump-over cannot push either fighter out of bounds.
invariants.detect: during a crossing the player X clamp relaxes to the full arena and min-separation is suspended; watch for the Vanguard being pushed through combat_axis_max by landing overlap resolution

invariants.statement: A knocked-out player deals no damage.
invariants.detect: vanguard health delta while bPlayerKO is true

invariants.statement: The Vanguard is not cancel-locked out of every attack it starts.
invariants.detect: fraction of started attacks reaching PerformImpactCheck under continuous player punching; a fraction at or near zero is the finding
invariants.system: BP_VanguardBasicAttackDriver — health-drop cancel in states 1 and 2
invariants.design_note: 1.4 s cancellable per attack against a 2.5-4.0 s cooldown that a cancel rerolls in full. If confirmed, the remedy is a design decision owned by the designer of record. This agent reports and does not resolve.

invariants.statement: Health stays within [0, max] for both fighters.
invariants.detect: health < 0 or health > max at any sample

invariants.statement: Both fighters are never knocked out at once.
invariants.detect: bVanguardKO and bPlayerKO both true
invariants.note: nothing in the build resolves a double KO

invariants.statement: Side sign flips exactly once per crossing.
invariants.detect: flip count between crossing open and close is not exactly 1

invariants.statement: A cancelled attack applies no damage.
invariants.detect: damage event after CancelAttack for the same attack instance

invariants.statement: Exactly one damage event per strike.
invariants.detect: more than one damage event between BeginStrike and FinishAttack

invariants.statement: Damage magnitude is exactly 10 in both directions.
invariants.detect: any health step that is not attack_damage or punch_damage

invariants.statement: A knocked-out fighter's health does not recover mid-match.
invariants.detect: health above 0 after that fighter's KO flag set

invariants.statement: A knockout reaches a stated result.
invariants.detect: no result state within a bounded window after a KO flag sets

invariants.statement: Position constraints stay enforced after a knockout.
invariants.detect: any positional invariant (B1 bounds, B3 capsule contact, B5 ordering) violated while either KO flag is set
invariants.system: BP_DuelKnockoutCoordinator.StopMover disables the mover tick; BP_VanguardDuelMover.ApplyConstraints runs on that tick
invariants.discovery: Found empirically by the live run on 2026-08-24 (seed 7), then formalized here. B1, B3 and B5 caught the symptoms; this invariant names the shared cause.
invariants.design_note: Exceeds known limitation K6. K6 accepts that the survivor may walk, jump and punch freely after a KO. It does not accept leaving the arena or passing through the other fighter's capsule.

known_limitations.statement: No victory or defeat resolution after a KO; the survivor acts freely and the loser stays down.
Same-frame punch-versus-impact trade, about one frame wide.
The ragdolled mesh can drift from its capsule; the camera frames capsules.
Telegraph exclamation yaw is fixed to the +Y camera side.
Vanguard max health hardcoded as 100 in both its graph and the HUD divisor.
Post-KO the surviving player can walk, jump and punch freely.
Ragdoll settle depends on template physics assets; no per-bone tuning and no impulse.
Player boundary behaviour is walk-in-place at the edge; no input suppression.
Template jump, fall and land timing was authored for slower arcs than GravityScale 1.9; foot-skate persists.

harness_parameters._note: Detection thresholds owned by the QA harness. They change how sensitive the agent is, never how the game behaves. They are NOT design values.

finding_schema.location: the actor and system, e.g. BP_VanguardDuelMover.ApplyConstraints
finding_schema.error_type: one of: boundary_break, stuck_state, exploit, logic_violation
finding_schema.game_context: what the duel state was — health, positions, separation, side sign, attack state, crossing flag, elapsed time
